text.content:
The borough that moved: the university, City Hall, and the Valentinos' home.

Region: Night City, south. Districts: Wellsprings (J), the Glen (K), Vista del Rey (L)
Controlled by: The NCPD from Precinct 1 in the Glen; NCU Security on campus; the Valentinos in Vista del Rey
The feel of it: City Hall scrubbed for the cameras, middle-class waterfront, and an old Combat Zone the gang made into a home
Notable locations: Night City University, Bulwark, MAX-TAC HQ, Savage Docs, the Slammer; City Hall, the Hall of Justice, El Coyote Cojo, Embers, Time Machine; La Catrina, Mercado Sonora, Delamain HQ, Moto Cielo
Danger: Moderate / Combat in Wellsprings; Corporate / Moderate in the Glen; Combat / Moderate in Vista del Rey

In 2045 Heywood was the docks and factories south of the river. Then North Heywood's people pushed south into the old University District and South Night City, the factories became Arroyo, and Heywood's name went with the people. Now it's three districts: Wellsprings, with the university and the port; the Glen, with City Hall and the courts; and Vista del Rey, the old Combat Zone, which the Valentinos have turned into a home.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.18; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.10
